user.title: Victron VRM
user.description: Create an access token in VRM: Preferences → Integrations → Access tokens.

site.title: Installation
site.description: Pick the installation. History is fetched from the start date (default: the day the installation was added to VRM).

reauth_confirm.title: New VRM access token
reauth_confirm.description: VRM rejected the current token. Enter a new one.

abort.wrong_account: The new token does not have access to this installation.

resync.name: Re-sync history
resync.description: Fetch the VRM history again for the months between the two dates.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First day to re-fetch (its whole month is re-fetched).

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day to re-fetch. Defaults to today.

summary.name: Summary
summary.description: Energy totals for a day, month or year, with a ready-made notification text. Without a date it returns the last complete period (yesterday, last month, last year).

date.name: Date
date.description: Any day inside the period. Defaults to the last complete period.

config_entry_id.name: Installation
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one VRM installation.
